The candidate operations all either modify only `msg.sender`'s own account/funds, enforce a role/modifier, or apply deterministic contract-defined state updates without letting the caller choose an arbitrary recipient or protected state value.

- `updateState`: permissionless state synchronization; it applies contract-defined interest/fee/expired-withdrawal processing and does not accept caller-controlled parameters to redirect funds or alter arbitrary user balances.
- `depositUpTo` / `deposit`: deposit pulls funds from `msg.sender` and mints to `msg.sender`; `_getAccountWithRole(msg.sender, AuthRole.DepositAndWithdraw)` enforces deposit authorization.
- `collectFees`: transfers available fees only to the fixed `feeRecipient`; the caller cannot redirect the transfer or choose the recipient.
- `borrow`: protected by `onlyBorrower` and transfers to the borrower.
- `closeMarket`: protected by `onlyController`.

No valid access-control sink is present.
